listing.shortDescription: Live basketball games, stats, scores & merch for SBBL, WBL, and TGIFBL leagues.
listing.fullDescription:
SBBL HQ is the official app for the SBBL (Sunday's Best Basketball League), WBL (Weekend Basketball League), and TGIFBL (Thank God It's Friday Basketball League) — three community basketball leagues under the Apex Business Systems organization based in Alberta, Canada.

⛹️ LIVE GAMES
• Watch games live with real-time streaming
• Pay-per-view access for fans, free for registered players
• Multi-camera support with low-latency WebRTC delivery

📊 STATS & LEADERBOARDS
• Full box scores for every game
• Season-long player statistics across all three leagues
• Points, rebounds, assists, steals, blocks, and shooting percentages
• Dynamic leaderboards with league and season filtering

📅 SCHEDULES & SCORES
• Complete game schedules for all leagues
• Live scores updated in real-time
• Team standings and win/loss records

👤 PLAYER PROFILES
• Personal player cards with headshot, bio, and stats
• Track your performance across seasons
• Compare stats with other players

🎬 MEDIA
• Game highlights and recaps
• League news and announcements
• Photo galleries from game nights

🛒 MERCH STORE
• Official league merchandise
• Team jerseys and apparel
• Secure checkout powered by Stripe

🏀 THREE LEAGUES, ONE APP
Whether you play in SBBL, WBL, or TGIFBL — everything lives in one place. Switch between leagues seamlessly.

Free player roster registration available for all league participants. Player Premium Season Pass: $6.99 CAD/season — includes full player profile, verified stat tracking, leaderboard eligibility, highlight downloads, and store discounts.

apple.appStoreReviewNotes: This app provides live basketball game streaming, player stats, schedules, and merchandise for three community basketball leagues in Alberta, Canada. Test account credentials can be provided upon request. The app offers free player roster registration as well as a Player Premium Season Pass ($6.99 CAD/season) for advanced player features. Pay-per-view is available for individual games.
